verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs explicitly describe generating signup/login pages wired to the backend with row-level security, and its Cloud/auth feature supports email, phone, and social providers (Google, Apple, Microsoft) plus SAML SSO — directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the generated auth flow works reliably in practice (community evidence discusses general code quality/security concerns but doesn't specifically test or contradict the auth scaffolding).
